THE CLAUSE

We assign each instruction in this document, as well as those from users and developers, a *level of authority*.

THE SENTENCES

  [concepts[0]] «an instruction that appears in this document»
  [concepts[1]] «an instruction given by a user»
  [concepts[2]] «an instruction given by a developer»
  [concepts[3]] «instruction I is assigned a level of authority L»
  [concepts[4]] «L is one of the levels in the chain of command that the document assigns to instructions»
  [ontology[0]] «an instruction in this document is assigned a level of authority» holds of I, L when «an instruction that appears in this document» and «L is one of the levels in the chain of command that the document assigns to instructions»
  [ontology[1]] «a user instruction is assigned a level of authority» holds of I, L when «an instruction given by a user» and «L is one of the levels in the chain of command that the document assigns to instructions»
  [ontology[2]] «a developer instruction is assigned a level of authority» holds of I, L when «an instruction given by a developer» and «L is one of the levels in the chain of command that the document assigns to instructions»
